description_text:
Low poly, game-ready UFO model, made in Blender for the Cycles renderer, with a PBR material. It has an animation cycle and a handling object to position it without messing up the animation. Ideal for SciFi scenes. The glass dome on the top has an emission material that you can change the color of in the software of your choosing.

  - Texture maps are in 1024p

  - Diffuse, Metal, Roughness, Metal and Emission maps included

  - Emission shader node comes attached through a Mix-Shader node

  - Simple 3-point-lighting setup, only for display

  - An empty controls the position of the animated model while the model itself is animated on a repeating loop of 6 keyframes, so it wobbles.

description_text:
Attention: THIS MODEL IS NOT INTENDED FOR 3D PRINTING. The meshes are NOT WATERTIGHT. The meshes are optimized for 3d game engines, the inside faces are deleted to save on tris count.
This pack contains a scifi drone with modular weapons.
The model is unskinned, unrigged and has no animations. Almost all 3D applications/game engines have their own built-in toolset for keyframe animations. Use this to create e.g. firing animations, etc.

  -   scifi drone A12

  -   modular weapon design

  -   canon, minigun, laser, grenade launcher and missile launcher

  -   engines are separate meshes and can rotate

  -   5 different texture sets

  -   PSDs with intact layers are included

  -   PBR textures (metallic)

  -   Ready to use prefabs of all models are included

  -   Texture sizes are 4096 (drone), 2048 (weapons)

  -   Tris count ca. 3600

  -   Final tris count depends on how many weapons are used for the drone

The textures can be used in a PBR environment (metalness workflow) as well as a non PBR environment.

  -   Albedo map, PNG format

  -   AlbedoAO map, PNG format – this albedo map has the ambient occlusion backed into it

  -   Ambient Occlusion (AO) map, PNG format

  -   Illumination maps (color + black/white)

  -   Normal map, PNG format

  -   Metalness map, PNG format

  -   Gloss map, PNG format

  -   Roughness map, PNG format

Depending on your game engine/3D application you may need to rescale the models.

description_text:
TIE BOMBER B2BThe Empire used flights of TIE bombers to drop vast quantities of munitions on rebellious planets and targets in space, delivering devastating attacks with frightening accuracy.
The TIE bomber, simply known as the TIE bomber or T/B, was a larger, less maneuverable TIE starfighter used for destroying large starships and pinpoint-precision bombing. The sa in the TIE bomber's designation stood for surface assault.
Due to their distinctive dual-hull shape, TIE bombers came to be referred to occasionally as dupes or (albeit indirectly) sitting ducks by enemy pilots. The latter nickname was due to its bulky structure making it much slower and far less maneuverable than other TIE craft.
BOILER PLATE
DESIGN:This version is my own design.It's scaled to match the cockpit can from the earlier(free), version of this star ship.It was rendered in Daz Studios and as such is guaranteed only in Daz or poser rendering systems.I tied to make it work as closely as I could with a more or less, realistic physics vessel but it could still use some adjustments in its engineering.
ADDITIONAL FORMATS:There is an obj format supplied for you to customize as you desire.
This model comes only with materials and no UV's or textures.What you see in the renderings is just that, the only "pizzazz being the emission controls built into the parts.
UPDATES:There will be one more version of this model available for sale later next month, on this site that will include what you currently see in this model but also include various operable hatches, equipment doors and service panels for hanger deck rendering.
I hope you enjoy using it as much as I enjoyed making it.
REVIEWS:Please be kind enough after downloading it, to add a review of the model so I can correct what needs correcting. Also, any and all suggestions are welcome so that I can continue to improve on it.
USES:Please follow the guidelines of the licensing and as always, please add a link to your finished work. I'd love to see how you use it!

description_text:
This gunship hybrid between plane and helicopter comes with a wide selection of armament aligned on Warhammer 40k standards. (could be played as a “storm talon”)
This item assembles like a real model with a set of 38 fitted parts.

  -   The main axis should not be glued to allow main turbines to rotate on that axis.

  -   The propellers can be let loose inside of the turbine and therefore can rotate.

  -   Front and side turret are designed to receive 8mm magnets to allow rotation and swapping of weapons easily.

  -   Cockpit comes in 2 versions: solid and hollow. I do not have the ability to print a transparent version but if you can you can add a pilot to it.

  -   Filamentfriendly: this model has been tested several times with filament printer (best config: 2 perimeters, 15%infill, speed at 100 height of layers at 0.1)

Note with filament printers the fitted parts will sometime have to be slightly shaved to fit in their emplacements.
Please do not hesitate to leave your feedbacks.
Have fun!

description_text:
Devil sticks vary widely in size and construction materials, but the batons are generally based on one of two basic designs: tapered and straight. Tapered batons are tapered from the ends towards the middle such that the middle is thinner than the ends. Straight batons are uniform in width but have weights attached to the ends. Rarely, a hybrid design consisting of a tapered baton with weights attached to the ends is used.
Illuminated devilsticks can create interesting visual effects in darkness with the use of battery-powered electric 'seed' bulbs; LEDs; or with phosphorescent or chemiluminescent materials.

POE dameron's A-wing for starwars fan is a high quality, photo real low poly model that will enhance detail and realism to any of your rendering projects.   - Models resolutions are optimized for polygon efficiency. (In 3ds Max, the Meshsmooth function can be used to increase mesh resolution if necessary.)

  - All colors can be easily modified.

  - Model is fully textured with all materials applied.

  - All textures and materials are included and mapped in every format.

  - 3ds Max models are grouped for easy selection, and objects are logically named for ease of scene management.

  - No part-name confusion when importing several models into a scene.

  - No cleaning up necessaryjust drop your models into the scene and start rendering.

  - No special plugin needed to open scene.

  - Model does not include any backgrounds or scenes used in preview images.

  - Units: mm

description_text:
The Eomanis Armored Fighting Vehicle is primarally a close support weapons platform. Eschewing sponson mounts it instead relies on a twin-turret system in order to provide both fire support and tank hunting capacity to an assault.  Inside it's cargo bay up to 6 heavy infantry or 12 light infantry can be seated, along with their wargear and additional amunition and supplies.
Files come pre-supported and the rear mounted turret is cross compatible with sectons from the Taurus Combat vehicle, Euphractus Armored, and Euphractus Support vehicles. description_text:
Model is made by hand by myself, a complete recreation of the Super Star Destroyer shown in the Empire Strikes back, it is highly detailed and scaled to be printed at 15 inched long. However, due to it's high level of detail, you can print this up to 2-4 feet long and it will look just as impressive, no details lost. This file contains the full version and the sliced version, with a bow and stern. The ship is made with care and I'm sure you will love it. The most distinguished Super Star Destroyer was the Executor, flagship of the Dark Lord of the Sith, Darth Vader.

A bridge deflector shield was also included as a layer of defense and maintained a complement of thousands of starships including TIE/ln space superiority starfighters, TIE/sa bombers, and TIE/IN interceptors. Vessels of the Executor-class also had at least one hangar bay and escape pods.
The Executor-class's bridge was 285 meters wide and contained shield generators, briefing rooms, and escape pods. However, it was relatively exposed, making it vulnerable to enemy attack.

Stylized Green Lantern Ring for 3dPrinting
This ring was made based on the ring used by the character Green Lantern.
Several individuals have assumed the name of Green Lantern over time. Each had a ring that gave them great control over the physical world. The ring was considered the most powerful weapon in the galaxy, creating complex shaped objects according to the mind of its bearer, limited only by two things: the Green Lantern willpower and the yellow color where the ring has no effect at all ( problem caused by an impurity in the original source that generated the rings). 
The Ring of the Green Lanterns must be recharged according to the rotation period of its carrier's home planet (on Earth, every 24 Hours). The battery of the ring resembled the old lantern used for example by the railwaymen to signal something on the rails to train drivers.
The rings of the Green Lanterns were made by the Guardians of the Universe, extremely ancient beings and powerful, who have the mission to watch over the maintenance of intergalactic peace. description_text:
Pallet/ Pump Truck - AKA Pallet Jack.
Damaged, rusty, old pump truck from a warehouse. 
Model made using Wings3D - PBR Textures created in Substance Painter 2019.2
Game-ready, Low-Poly, Unity and Unreal friendly. 1 Mesh, 1 texture set.
I have included the Alpha textures in a zip for anyone that may want them for Substance Painter.
The jack is steered by a 'tiller' like lever that also acts as the pump handle for raising the jack. A small handle on the tiller releases the hydraulic fluid, causing the forks to lower. The front wheels inside the end of the forks are mounted on levers attached to linkages that go to levers attached to the jack cylinder. As the hydraulic jack at the 'tiller' end is raised, the links force the wheels down, raising the forks vertically above the front wheels, raising the load upward until it clears the floor. The pallet is only lifted enough to clear the floor for subsequent travel. Oftentimes, pallet jacks are used to move and organize pallets inside a trailer, especially when there is no forklift truck access or availability.

description_text:
Set of various Sci-fi and industrial objects, ideal for any game environment.

Contains:

  - Barrel (red and green variant)

  - Cap (7 colors – Blue, Cyan, Green, Magenta, Red, White, Yellow)

  - Component

  - Container (clean and dirty variant)

  - Device (dark and glowing variant)

  - Fuel Hose

All assets are using PBR (specular) shader. Each mesh has custom Albedo, Specular/Smoothness, Normal and Ambient Occlusion maps in loseless 4096 px resolution, ready for any desired downscaling.Available as a complete Unity package file and standalone Asset archive (meshes + textures). Unity package all set up for Universal Scriptable Rendering Pipeline (models and texures are backward compatible with Standard–Specular or convertible into HDRP).
Contents:
36 prop textures (4096 x 4096 pixels)

  - Albedo (specular workflow)

  - Ambient Oclussion

  - Smoothness

  - Specular

  - Normal

  - Emission

6 prop meshes (UV mapped) with LoD variants in FBX format

  - Barrel (red and green variant) with 6 LoD variants  - 2756 / 1596 / 836 / 386 / 116 / 52 triangles

  - Cap (Blue, Cyan, Green, Magenta, Red, White, Yellow variant) with 2 LoD variants  - 260 / 116 triangles

  - Component with 3 LoD variants  - 1296 / 1088 / 608 triangles

  - Container (clean and dirty variant) with 2 LoD variants  - 1144 / 572 triangles

  - Device (dark and glowing variant) with 3 LoD variants  - 9164 / 3356 / 1796 triangles

  - Fuel Hose with 6 LoD variants  - 707 / 1412 / 2483 / 4352 / 8478 / 16277 triangles

15 URP PBR (specular) materials (Unity package)
15 prefabs (Unity package)
1 preview scene with camera orbit script and related utility files (Unity package)

This is Version 1 model please check my store for version 2 of this model.
Note : Sir/Mam Before Buy this Model please check into my store, I have this model with a collection which will get huge discount. Thanks
Game ready For Unity(Standard), Unity HD Render Pipeline, Unreal Engine and etc include Virtual Reality (VR), Augmented Reality (AR), Movies/Film, Interior/Exterior design and other real-time apps. Made for use in Video Games but you can use it for basically anything.  

  - Originally created in maya 2019 

  - PBR : Yes

  - Clean UV: Yes, Partial overlapping in the UV's to save space

|SPEC|Geometry: 

  - Polys: 19881

  - Tris: 38988

  - Verts: 21536

|3D Model File Formats|

  -  .Ma + .Max

  -  .3DS + .Fbx + .Obj + .dae + .Abc 

  -  .unitypackage + .uasset

All textures are include in zip file, textures map for PBR MetalRough, Unity(Standard), Unity HD Render Pipeline, Unreal Engine, Arnold, V-Ray, Renderman, Redshift, KeyShot, Maxwell, Spark AR Studio and More!!!
Includes 2 Set textures map(Clean, Dirty) with Texture Dimension 4096x4096 and 8192x8192.
(Sample of PBR MetalRough Basic Textures set)

  - 4096x4096 Albedo(Basecolor) 

  - 4096x4096 Metallic

  - 4096x4096 Roughness 

  - 4096x4096 Normal Map DirectX & OpenGL(Both included) 

  - 4096x4096 Ambient occlusion (AO)

|General Char| 

  - Game Ready model 

  - Modeled in Maya

  - Low poly Mesh 

  - No ngons 

  - No seams

  - No Plugin needs 

  - No hidden geometry 

  - Object pivot points at 0,0,0. 

  - Object scaled to approximate real world size (cm) 

  - Approximate dimensions: W:2580cm x L:13955cm x H: 8229cm

  - Scene organized by layers 

  - Arrange properly the files and rename the layers 

  - High Poly mesh baked on Low Poly mesh. 

  - Model is fully textured with all materials applied. 

Note : - Product does not include high mesh

  - 20ft cargo container not included in this package, sir/mam can buy its separately (can get in my store at cheap price at 5$ only) or in collections mode with some discounts. 

  - Triangulate mesh and Quad both are included in folder 

  - Partial overlapping in the UV's to save space.

  - Free Ambient occlusion textures are also included 

  - Included substance painter file which you can edit your own logo/text and you also can change the texture Color or increased/decreased the Dirty level then export those textures for use in any engine.

description_text:
Trainstation bench inspired by the 1900's travelling images. Base model was made in Blender, and textures were made with Substance Painter. This bench is created out of 4 objects which form the bench composition. Objects are all parented to an Empty for easier use in the scene. Size of the composition is 217x64.5x106 cm, but if needed, you can create longer bench by using separated objects. No trunks included, they are sold separately.
This model was created with high quality rendered images in mind, such as arch-viz projects, but can also be used for games or other projects. If you intend to use it in a game engine, please be advised that you'll need to bring the polycount of the handrest part down because it has a lot of edge loops to control the curved shape. 
Textures that come with this model are: base_color, roughness, and normal map (openGL). All in 4K resolution, so you can scale them down safely in any photo editing software, if you need lower resolution. For better resolution of the textures, this composition uses 3 different UV sets and materials. If using with a game engine, it is recomended that you channel pack the textures for saving memory usage, or you if you want everything to be placed on a single UV channel and material, you can contact me and I'll repack the layout and rebake the textures for you.
If you're having any issues or questions with this model, or you need something changed, feel free to contact me any time.
Thank you for your purchase.

description_text:
What lies in the old metro station? Maybe monsters? Or survivors? Or maybe just the small workplace of a maintenance guy. With this pack, you can create the scene of your imaginations.
The contents in this pack range from environment pieces to props to decorate the scene. Most of the assets do not include unique textures but use the same texture to provide the surface. This means it is easy to create different variations of the scene with the textures you have amassed to your library.
The poly count of the objects varies between 28 and 23,380 with most being between 1000 and 2000 so these are well optimized to be used in real-time applications and can run even on mobile! Texture resolution varies between 2048px and 4096px.
All the materials are made using PBR workflow, which results in high-quality assets in any situation. Models utilize weighed normals workflow, which means the models are high quality without large normal maps or extra vertices. Assets are usable in various situations ranging from VR to games and mobile to visualizations.
Models include the following textures:

  - Albedo

  - Normal Map

  - Packed PBR (Roughness, Metalness, Ambient Occlusion)

The packaged PBR texture has the following textures assigned on RGB channels:

  - Red = Ambient Occlusion

description_text:
Rockland station is a railway station located at Union and Pleasant Streets in Rockland, Maine. It is the eastern terminus of the Rockland Branch, a state-owned track connecting Rockland and Brunswick. The historic station building was built in 1917 by the Maine Central Railroad, and was listed on the National Register of Historic Places in 1978 as Rockland Railroad Station. It presently houses a restaurant, and served for a time as Rockland's city hall. The line is presently inactive, having most recently had seasonal passenger service from 2004 to 2015 operated by the now-defunct Maine Eastern Railroad. The line has been leased to the Central Maine and Quebec Railway, which is planning to reintroduce service on the line, but not with excursions.
All materials are signed, models too.
The geometry is clean, built mainly on quadrangles (95%), no N-gons, no coplanar faces
The size of textures varies from 2049x2048 to 8192x8192
The scale is set to 'real world' (1 unit = 1 cm).
The model is checked for errors, no errors.
The model was created on 3ds max 2016, texturing in Substance painter.
The interior has not been worked out, only the walls.

Game ready For Unity(Standard), Unity HD Render Pipeline, Unreal Engine and etc include Virtual Reality (VR), Augmented Reality (AR), Movies/Film, Interior/Exterior design and other real-time apps. Made for use in Video Games but you can use it for basically anything.  

  - Originally created in Maya 2019

  - PBR : Yes

  - Clean UV: Yes, Partial overlapping in the UV's to save space

  - Rendered with Marmoset Toolbag 4 and Marmoset Scene included in file 

|SPEC|Geometry: 

  - Polys: 32500

  - Tris: 64340

  - Verts: 37853

|3D Model File Formats|

  -  .Ma + .Max

  -  .3DS + .Fbx + .Obj + .dae + .Abc 

  -  .unitypackage + .uasset

All textures are include in zip file, textures map for PBR MetalRough, Unity(Standard), Unity HD Render Pipeline, Unreal Engine, Arnold, V-Ray, Renderman, Redshift, KeyShot, Maxwell, Spark AR Studio and More!!!
Includes 2 Set textures map(Clean, Dirty) with Texture Dimension 4096x4096 and 8192x8192.
(Sample of PBR MetalRough Basic Textures set)

  - 4096x4096 Albedo(Basecolor) 

  - 4096x4096 Metallic

  - 4096x4096 Roughness 

  - 4096x4096 Normal Map DirectX & OpenGL(Both included) 

  - 4096x4096 Ambient occlusion (AO)

|General Char| 

  - Game Ready model 

  - Modeled in Maya

  - Low poly Mesh 

  - No ngons 

  - No seams

  - No Plugin needs 

  - No hidden geometry 

  - Object pivot points at 0,0,0. 

  - Object scaled to approximate real world size (cm) 

  - Approximate dimensions: W:2175cm x L:5600cm x H: 2800cm 

  - Scene organized by layers 

  - Arrange properly the files and rename the layers 

  - High Poly mesh baked on Low Poly mesh. 

  - Model is fully textured with all materials applied. 

Note : - Product does not include high mesh

  - Triangulate mesh and Quad both are included in folder 

  - Partial overlapping in the UV's to save space.

  - Texture Quality Guarantee

  - Free Ambient occlusion textures are also included

This is Version 2 model please check my store for version 1 of this model.
Note : Sir/Mam Before Buy this Model please check into my store, I have this model with a collection which will get huge discount. Thanks
Game ready For Unity(Standard), Unity HD Render Pipeline, Unreal Engine and etc include Virtual Reality (VR), Augmented Reality (AR), Movies/Film, Interior/Exterior design and other real-time apps. Made for use in Video Games but you can use it for basically anything.  

  - Originally created in Maya 2019

  - PBR : Yes

  - Clean UV: Yes, Partial overlapping in the UV's to save space

  - Rendered with Marmoset Toolbag 4 and Marmoset Scene included in file 

|SPEC|Geometry: 

  - Polys: 30560

  - Tris: 60508

  - Verts: 35537

|3D Model File Formats|

  -  .Ma + .Max

  -  .3DS + .Fbx + .Obj + .dae + .Abc 

  -  .unitypackage + .uasset

All textures are include in zip file, textures map for PBR MetalRough, Unity(Standard), Unity HD Render Pipeline, Unreal Engine, Arnold, V-Ray, Renderman, Redshift, KeyShot, Maxwell, Spark AR Studio and More!!!
Includes 2 Set textures map(Clean, Dirty) with Texture Dimension 4096x4096 and 8192x8192.
(Sample of PBR MetalRough Basic Textures set)

  - 4096x4096 Albedo(Basecolor) 

  - 4096x4096 Metallic

  - 4096x4096 Roughness 

  - 4096x4096 Normal Map DirectX & OpenGL(Both included) 

  - 4096x4096 Ambient occlusion (AO)

|General Char| 

  - Game Ready model 

  - Modeled in Maya

  - Low poly Mesh 

  - No ngons 

  - No seams

  - No Plugin needs 

  - No hidden geometry 

  - Object pivot points at 0,0,0. 

  - Object scaled to approximate real world size (cm) 

  - Approximate dimensions: W:2107cm x L:5600cm x H: 2740cm 

  - Scene organized by layers 

  - Arrange properly the files and rename the layers 

  - High Poly mesh baked on Low Poly mesh. 

  - Model is fully textured with all materials applied. 

Note : - Product does not include high mesh

  - Triangulate mesh and Quad both are included in folder 

  - Partial overlapping in the UV's to save space.

  - Texture Quality Guarantee

  - Free Ambient occlusion textures are also included 

  - 40ft cargo container not included in this package, sir/mam can buy its separately (can get in my store at cheap price at 5$ only) or in collections mode with some discounts.

  - Included substance painter file which you can edit your own logo/text and you also can change the texture Color or increased/decreased the Dirty level then export those textures for use in any engine.

This is Version 2 model please check my store for version 1 of this model.
Note : Sir/Mam Before Buy this Model please check into my store, I have this model with a collection which will get huge discount. Thanks
Game ready For Unity(Standard), Unity HD Render Pipeline, Unreal Engine and etc include Virtual Reality (VR), Augmented Reality (AR), Movies/Film, Interior/Exterior design and other real-time apps. Made for use in Video Games but you can use it for basically anything.  

  - Originally created in Maya 2019

  - PBR : Yes

  - Clean UV: Yes, Partial overlapping in the UV's to save space

  - Rendered with Marmoset Toolbag 4 and Marmoset Scene included in file 

|SPEC|
Geometry Model 1:              

  - Polys: 29642

  - Tris: 58158

  - Verts: 33885

Geometry Model 2: (Extra tyre casing)  

  - Polys: 31034 

  - Tris: 60942

  - Verts: 35613

|3D Model File Formats|

  -  .Ma + .Max

  -  .3DS + .Fbx + .Obj + .dae + .Abc 

  -  .unitypackage + .uasset

All textures are include in zip file, textures map for PBR MetalRough, Unity(Standard), Unity HD Render Pipeline, Unreal Engine, Arnold, V-Ray, Renderman, Redshift, KeyShot, Maxwell, Spark AR Studio and More!!!
Includes 2 Set textures map(Clean, Dirty) with Texture Dimension 4096x4096 and 8192x8192.
(Sample of PBR MetalRough Basic Textures set)

  - 4096x4096 Albedo(Basecolor) 

  - 4096x4096 Metallic

  - 4096x4096 Roughness 

  - 4096x4096 Normal Map DirectX & OpenGL(Both included) 

  - 4096x4096 Ambient occlusion (AO)

|General Char| 

  - Game Ready model 

  - Modeled in Maya

  - Low poly Mesh 

  - No ngons 

  - No seams

  - No Plugin needs 

  - No hidden geometry 

  - Object pivot points at 0,0,0. 

  - Object scaled to approximate real world size (cm) 

  - Approximate dimensions: W: 1221cm x L: 2640cm x H: 2268 cm 

  - Scene organized by layers 

  - Arrange properly the files and rename the layers 

  - High Poly mesh baked on Low Poly mesh. 

  - Model is fully textured with all materials applied. 

Note : - Product does not include high mesh

  - Triangulate mesh and Quad both are included in folder 

  - Partial overlapping in the UV's to save space.

  - Texture Quality Guarantee

  - Free Ambient occlusion textures are also included 

  - 40ft cargo container not included in this package, sir/mam can buy its separately (can get in my store at cheap price at 5$ only) or in collections mode with some discounts.

  - Included substance painter file which you can edit your own logo/text and you also can change the texture Color or increased/decreased the Dirty level then export those textures for use in any engine.

description_text:
This kit is intended for adding passenger railways to city scenes composed of Kit 01 (Kit 01 can be downloaded at https://www.cgtrader.com/free-3d-models/exterior/cityscape/building-blocks-for-modern-city-scenes-kit01 for free). There are two file formats in this kit: FBX and OBJ. Each format includes six files: three files containing building-block modules, and three files containing examples composed of the modules from this kit and Kit 01. More details are as the following.
(1) Modules in this kit: The file Kit02_Modules01 contains modules of roads, railway tracks, and vehicles (figure 02). Kit02_Modules02 contains a railway station module (figure 03). And Kit02_Modules03 contains other building modules (figure 04). The modules are made using SketchUp 8 and then exported to Blender 2.83 for file format conversion and rendering. The converted files still have the original SketchUp material settings, and the rendered appearances of the modules are shown in figures 02~04. Relevant materials are assigned names describing how they should look or what they should look like, such as red_smooth, yellow_rough, concrete, asphalt, ..., etc. The orientation setting is Y forward and Z up.
(2) Assembly Instructions: Regular steps of assembly include copying and pasting, rotating, and moving the modules. The modules are color-coded. A color-coded surface may be attached to a surface with the same color or a white surface (figure 05). The material names of the color-coded surfaces are color_code_00, color_code_01, ..., etc. Each file containing modules also contains a color code palette (figure 06). If modules from two different files are to be assembled, it is better to make sure in advance that the two palettes have the same color settings.
(3) Examples: The three examples are composed of modules from this kit and Kit 01. The file Kit02_Example01 shows an example of road and railway networks (figure 07). The road network is similar to those in Kit 01 examples. And the railway tracks are either elevated or lowered to avoid interferences with the ground traffic. Kit02_Example02 shows road and railway networks and a railway station (figure 10). The design of the railway station assumes that railways roughly form a rectangular network, and each major railway station locates at an intersection of two perpendicular railways. Adding buildings, trees, and vehicles to Kit02_Example02 results in Kit02_Example03 (figure 11). Using additional material settings, the rendered results of this example are shown in figures 12~25, but the additional material settings are not included in this kit. The tris number of Kit02_Example03 is 894,871. In the rendered figures, the red trains are long-distance trains, and the blue trains are commuter trains.
(4) Versions: This is the first version of this kit and was published on 2021/08/31.

description_text:
Mid Wales Brake Van  by a photo in Cambrian Railways Album Vol 1 by C.C. Green .Brake van and guard's van are terms used mainly in the UK, Australia and India for a railway vehicle equipped with a hand brake which can be applied by the guard. The equivalent North American term is caboose, but a British brake van and a caboose are very different in appearance, because the former usually has only four wheels, while the latter usually has bogies. German railways employed Brakeman's cabins combined into other cars.
Many British freight trains formerly had no continuous brake so the only available brakes were those on the locomotive and the brake van. Because of this shortage of brake power, the speed was restricted to 25 mph (40 km/h). The brake van was marshalled at the rear of the train so both portions of the train could be brought to a stand in the event of a coupling breaking.
When freight trains were fitted with continuous braking, brake vans lost their importance, and were discontinued by many railways. However, they still continue on some important railways, such as the Indian Railways, besides the heritage railways.

description_text: A railroad crane (North America: crane car or wrecker; UK: breakdown crane) is a type of crane used on a railroad for one of three primary purposes: freight handling in goods yards, permanent way (PW) maintenance, and accident recovery work. This crane is a hand-operated model that was used to lay the tracks in the early twentieth centuryThe most varied forms of crane are used for maintenance work. General purpose cranes may be used for installing signalling equipment or pointwork, for example, while more specialised types are used for track laying. A railroad crane generally resembles a conventional fixed-location crane except that the platform the crane sits on is a heavy-duty reinforced flat car. Directly underneath the center of gravity for the crane is a pivot point that allows the crane to swivel around 360°; in this way the crane can locate its boom over the worksite no matter what its location is along the track. The trucks on the car under the crane will often include traction motors so that the crane is able to move itself along the track, and possibly tow additional cars.Larger cranes may be provided with outriggers to provide additional stability when lifting. Sleepers (ties) are often carried on the idler car to put under the outriggers to spread the weight applied to the trackbed.Breakdown cranes (sometimes called wrecking cranes or 'big hooks') were necessary to every railroad to recover derailed rolling stock and locomotives, while also assisting with bridge building and yard construction.

description_text:
JUMBO COFFEE TABLES by GAE AULENTI for KNOLL INTERNATIONAL
The Jumbo coffee table was more than just a piece of furniture to Gae Aulenti (1927–2012). As a participant in Italy’s Neo-Liberty movement in the late 1950s, she rejected the omnipresent Bauhaus modernist aesthetic and instead chose to create pieces that exemplified her taste for classical design with a modern edge. The Jumbo coffee table, with its opulent marble top and sculpted column legs, epitomized Aulenti's approach. Weighing nearly 450 pounds, the table is unquestionably heavy yet it still maintains a graceful air that hearkens back to her adoration for classic Roman architecture. This is a characteristic of her late-career architectural projects, too, such as her conversion of a train station to the Musée d’Orsay — home to one of the world's most important Impressionist art collections — as well as the renovation of Venice’s Palazzo Grassi into an exhibition space.In 1954, decades before she transformed a Paris landmark transit hub into a museum, Aulenti graduated from the Polytechnic University of Milan as one of only two women in her class. She became known for her industrial design work and as a vocal advocate for rejecting postwar Italian architecture. Gianni Agnelli, the chairman of Fiat, was impressed with her passion and commissioned her to design his company’s showrooms in Turin, Zurich and Brussels. Aulenti’s work for Fiat yielded another design opportunity, this time, at Knoll, where she designed the company’s showrooms in Boston and New York City. In 1972, Knoll began to manufacture the Jumbo coffee table, which Aulenti initially designed in 1965. Jumbo coffee table in marble, designed by Gae Aulenti for Knoll International in the 1960s. Square table top with four cylindrical cluster legs.

description_text:
Ready-to-print super detailed items set for H0-scale Model Railroad. Graphic for the information signs is included. Please see the GRAPHIC.PDF in the package.The Print files (with correct supports, exposure time, lift speed and heights) are included and all neccesary preparations are made to simplify print. Simply download, un-zip, save to USB and print. Enjoy!
The models are developed and test printed on a range of 2k, 4k and 8k consumer grade resin printers to verify function, detail and printability. 
We recommend using the following mix of resins for high strength and super detail:
  - Mix 30% Anycubic Tough with 70% Anycubic ABS-like plus resin.
Use the following link for best price of your Anycubic purchases: https://store.anycubic.com/?ref=zwjjfwob at the same time as you support the Modelrailroad3D design work.
IMPORTANT GENERAL NOTE TO AVIOD WARPING / SCEWING:

  - WASHING: Wash all items clean from resin preferrably in a washing mashine 6-8 minutes (Anycubic Wash & Cure 2.0)

  - POST CURING:  Leave all items to dry after wash properly. Preferrably over-night / 24h.  All sides, including inside surfaces, MUST be exposed to the UV-light. Recommended time: 4 minutes.

  - Paint the details immidiatly after post-curing using a primer. We recommend TAMAIYA Surface Primer Fine Gray.

*The Editorial licence of course includes unlimited printing for your own Model Railroad. However, the 3D models provided in this set must NOT be used for commersial production or re-sale of the 3D-models.

Norfolk (/ˈnɔːrfək/) is a ceremonial and non-metropolitan county in East Anglia in England. It borders Lincolnshire to the north-west, Cambridgeshire to the west and south-west, and Suffolk to the south. Its northern and eastern boundaries are the North Sea, with The Wash to the north-west. The county town is the city of Norwich. With an area of 2,074 square miles (5,370 km2) and a population of 859,400, Norfolk is a largely rural county with a population density of 401 per square mile (155 per km2). "ince 1940, the main antitank, all-terrain fast vehicle in service with the US Army was the M6 GMC. It was a basic 4 wheeled truck equipped with a 37 mm (1.46 in) gun installed on the rear bed, only protected by a frontal mask. The crew was exposed, and the M6 was lightly protected.

description_text:
Shipping Containers, Storage Containers, Container Modifications & Mobile Office Units. As a cost-effective and modern option, shipping container offices are the office space solution of the future.
  - Eco-Friendly
For the environmentally conscious, recycling old shipping containers to create something useful is one of the main advantages of a shipping container office. There are shipping containers that are not currently being utilized, and by repurposing them in this way, it is a great way to give them a new purpose.

  - TransportableAnother major benefit of a shipping container office is that it can be transported easily. If your business needs to move, a smaller container can be transported on a truck – which means you can take your office almost anywhere.

  - Spacious OfficesWhile a shipping container may sound too small to provide ample office space, there are plenty of options that can provide adequate space. A medium-sized container is perfect for providing office space, as well as office storage, for 1 – 2 people. If you have more staff or need a lot of storage, a large container will be plenty big enough.

  - Temporary Office SpaceShipping container offices can be permanent. However, they also work well for temporary office spaces, such as at a construction site or during a renovation project within your current office building.

  - CustomizableShipping container offices are also completely customizable. Doors and windows can be added wherever they are needed. You can create rooms and walls easily depending upon your specific needs. Your shipping container starts as a blank slate that can be fully customized without the great expense of building a new permanent office structure or renovating a current building.

Wheels for truck/tractor
••••••••••••
Game-ready PBR model of a wheels for truck/tractor for your project. Model has 12 variations (4 colors + 3 levels of wearness), so it will be easy for you to use it in different scenes. Modeled in Maya, textured in Substance Painter, rendered in Marmoset Toolbag.

••••••••••••
Available by additional request: Marmoset Render Scene | Substance Painter project
••••••••••••

This collection of 3D models consists of 47 isometric assets, including 26 buildings, 7 vehicles, and 13 signboards. The buildings in this collection are designed in a cartoonish style, adding a unique charm to your projects. Each building can be used independently, allowing you to create complete cityscapes and beautiful urban landscapes. The vehicles, including various cars and transportation vehicles, bring movement and vibrancy to your scenes. The signboards, with their interesting designs and colors, can be placed on streets, buildings, or other areas of your city, adding character and creating a lively atmosphere.
These models offer flexibility and compatibility, as they are available in 3DsMax 2023,3Dsmax 2022,3Dsmax 2021,3Dsmax 2020, Blender, FBX, OBJ, PNG and PDF formats. You can choose the format that suits your project needs and seamlessly integrate them into your preferred software.
Feel free to unleash your creativity and share your imaginative world with others using these captivating cartoon-style 3D models. If you have any further questions or requests, I'm here to assist you.

description_text:
A hydraulic fluid gear pump powered by a three-phase electric moter.  Gear pumps are used to generate high-pressures in hydraulic fluids, in order to perform motion in another part of the machine.  They are used in skid-steers, excavators, bobcats, forklifts, etc.  
This model is cut away to see into the interior.  This is an excellent visualization for demonstrating how the gear pump works.  Whether you are using this for game design, animation, or educational videos, a cutaway will definitely capture your audience's interest.
Included:

  - three-phase electric motor.

  - detailed electric motor rotor.

  - motor cooling fan.

  - motor driveshaft.

  - helical gear reduction.

  - two pump gears to push fluid.

  - sleek, eye-catching casing design.

  - designed using actual dimensions (may need scaling though).

Features:-realistic materials packaged into a .mtl file.-extreme detail (over 350,000 triangles).-includes all the components of a real-life gear pump.-perfect for photorealistic rendering.
If you plan on animating the model with moving parts, please contact me.  I can provide you with all the individual parts, which includes a fee.

description_text:
An anchor is a fundamental nautical device that plays a crucial role in the maritime industry. This weighty apparatus is used to secure seafaring vessels, providing stability and preventing drift when they are not in motion. In this description, we will explore the key characteristics and functions of an anchor.
Paragraph 1:An anchor is typically constructed from solid materials such as steel or iron to ensure durability and strength. It consists of a central shank, flukes or blades that dig into the seabed, and a stock or crossbar that stabilizes the anchor's position. The design and size of the anchor vary depending on the type of vessel and the expected conditions it may encounter.
Paragraph 2:The primary function of an anchor is to hold a vessel in place when it is not underway. By dropping the anchor into the water and allowing it to grip the seabed, the vessel remains stationary, even in adverse weather conditions or strong currents. This ensures the safety of the vessel, its crew, and any cargo on board.
Paragraph 3:Anchors are designed to provide a firm hold in various types of seabeds, such as mud, sand, or rocky surfaces. The flukes or blades of the anchor are specifically shaped to penetrate the seabed and create a secure grip. The angle at which the anchor is set into the seabed, known as the anchor's bite, also affects its holding power.
Paragraph 4:To deploy the anchor, the vessel's crew lowers it over the bow or stern into the water using a chain or cable known as the anchor rode. The anchor rode connects the anchor to the vessel, allowing for easy retrieval and adjustment as needed. It is essential to choose the appropriate length and strength of the anchor rode based on the vessel's size and the anticipated anchoring conditions.
Paragraph 5:Anchoring is a skill that requires knowledge and experience. Proper anchor placement, taking into account factors such as wind, tides, and the nature of the seabed, is crucial for effective anchoring. The crew must also monitor the vessel's position and the anchor's hold to ensure its reliability, making adjustments if necessary.
Paragraph 6:In addition to its practical function, the anchor holds symbolic meaning in maritime culture. It represents stability, security, and a connection to the sea. Anchors are often used as motifs in maritime-themed artwork, jewelry, and tattoos, symbolizing strength and the ability to stay grounded even in challenging circumstances.
Conclusion:An anchor serves as a steadfast guardian for seafaring vessels, providing stability and security when they are at rest. With its robust construction, ability to grip various seabeds, and careful deployment, an anchor plays a vital role in ensuring the safety and well-being of vessels and their crews. Whether in practical applications or as a symbol of resilience, the anchor holds a significant place in maritime history and culture.

description_text: For all motorbike enthusiasts and Gear Heads... Now you can have a unique way to display all of those shop manuals! A good friend of mine that rides motorbikes handed me two carburetors and said, Here, make me some book ends So, after some noodling, I reverse engineered some cylinder heads to hold them and then fired up the 3d printer to print them out. I wanted to utilize some contrasting materials to highlight the metal parts while also creating a motor bike feel. So, I constructed the base from hardwood and stained it black and then added a stripe of painted aluminum to mimic the stripe that you might see on a gas tank. The combination of materials came together really well and the 3d printed parts look very realistic when combined with the other parts.

description_text:
The Tall Industries TI260 is a high-quality vintage motorcycle asset inspired by real-world 1970s–80s commuter bikes, including models popular in Central Europe such as the Simson S51, as well as classic Honda designs from the same era.

Dacia Front Badge Collection. Contains 4 Dacia emblems from 1968 till 2008. The latest one is the only one missing from the collection. STL files are available if you want to 3d print them. As a bonus, a UAP pin badge is included in this collection. That one is very rare and very old.

  - All models separated in different folder with preview picture included.

  - No isolated polygons, no coincident vertices or faces, no missing textures.

  - STL files provided only for 3d printing. They are 1:1 scale, so rescale them if you want to print them smaller.

Polygons 661Vertices 816

Polygons 113Vertices 124

description_text:
A Tie Fighter of Star Wars made in CATIA and rendering in Keyshot. Divided into 2 components, the main body of the spacecraft and the wings, and the assembly of the both parts.
The TIE/LN starfighter,or TIE/line starfighter, simply known as the TIE Fighter or T/F, was the standard Imperial starfighter seen in massive numbers throughout most of the Galactic Civil War and onward. Colloquially, Rebel and New Republic pilots referred to the craft as eyeballs. The TIE Fighter is the original design for later upgraded TIE models such as TIE/sa bomber, TIE/IN interceptor, TIE/D Defender, TIE/D automated starfighter, and many more. The TIE Fighter was a descendant of the T.I.E. starfighter and the V-wing starfighter, both developed for the Galactic Republic, and was manufactured by Sienar Fleet Systems. In addition to the T.I.E. and V-wing, it was also descended from the TIE starfighter, the first TIE model developed for the Galactic Empire. The namesake for the fighter and line was the Sienar Fleet Systems P-s4 twin ion engines that acted as its engines. However, it also to some degree was named after an item of clothing due to its overall shape resembling a bow-tie.

description_text:
Third attempt on a space ship. Texturing is getting better, not 100% there yet. Same with unwrapping. 
This model is carefully created to make sure it's quad based. And 98% or so are quads. I modeled this using subdevision on level 2. U might notice that the model is quite empty. That is for 2 reasons. I created the skeleton...and I'm not a creative type when it comes to filling it up. this gives you the freedom to add to it 100%. That said...there is little detail added to some parts. Details you don't see on the renders. Also I tried to make sure there are no useless faces. 
As for textures. The textures are a mix of 4k to 1/5k. 4k for the more obvious textures. 2k for the slighly less obvious. All the way down to 1/5k for small objects.
I custom painted some textures. Mostly the rust to add some more variation. And for the uvs. They shouldnt be overlapping. 
If you need a different export, please let me know. I only export my models in fbx and obj. But if requested ill export in whatever you need.

description_text:
Emiliano Zapata was a leading figure in the Mexican Revolution, during which he formed and commanded the Liberation Army of the South, an important revolutionary brigade.Who Was Emiliano Zapata?
Emiliano Zapata was a Mexican revolutionary and advocate of agrarianism who fought in guerrilla actions during the Mexican Revolution. He formed and commanded the Liberation Army of the South, an important revolutionary brigade, and his followers were known as Zapatistas. Zapata died on April 10, 1919.
Early Years
Born on August 8, 1879, Emiliano Zapata was orphaned at the age of 17. A revolutionary from an early age, in 1897 he was arrested because he took part in a protest by the peasants of his village against the hacienda (plantation) that had appropriated their lands. After he was pardoned, he continued to agitate among the peasants, and because of his rabble-rousing, he was subsequently drafted into the Mexican army. After serving for only six months, Zapata was discharged to a landowner to train his horses in Mexico City. In 1909 his leadership skills were already well known, and he was summoned to his village of birth, Anenecuilco, where he was elected as the village’s council board president.

description_text:
Heavy duty truck that was made using Blender. This is the first vehicle that I have ever created so feedback is welcome. This is a model with a mixture of highpoly parts and lowpoly parts. The model has four separated parts for easier managing. Each part also has their own set of textures. This model uses the metalness workflow and is PBR ready. It can be used in any situation that you want such as game development or scenes for example.
Features:

  - Model uses the metalness workflow and is PBR ready

  - Model is separated into four parts (truck parts, truck body, license plates, wheels)

  - Includes 21 PBR 2K textures in PNG format

  - Includes 4 UVLayout textures to show how each part of the model has been unwrapped

  - Create custom license plate images with license plate textures

  - Normal map included to add detail to the trunk of the model without adding extra geometry

  - Diffuse maps with alpha are included to make glass transparent on headlights

  - Overlapping UVs on mirrored/duplicate parts on some meshes to save texture space

  - All parts of the model have been manually unwrapped with matching PBR textures

  - The model has been organized neatly in its zip archive and labeled accordingly

  - Native blend file is included with pre-applied textures

  - Lights, cameras, and objects are grouped accordingly in a native blend file

  - Model has been exported in 3 file formats (FBX, OBJ, DAE/Collada)

  - Images in the description were rendered using the cycles engine

  - Video animation was rendered using the eevee engine in Blender 2.8 Beta

Included Texture Types:

  - AO, Diffuse(Alpha), Roughness, Gloss, Metallic, Normal

  - UVLayout

description_text:
Dumpster 3D asset that was made using Blender. This asset includes a clean and grunge diffuse texture. One texture is clean which could be modified and a premade texture that has a grunge look to it. They are easily interchangeable in the included Blend file. This asset was made using the metalness workflow and uses PBR textures.
Features:

  - Asset uses the metalness workflow and 2K PBR textures in PNG format

  - All textures can be modified

  - Includes premade grunge diffuse texture

  - Asset has been manually UV unwrapped to match its PBR textures

  - Blend file includes pre-applied textures and camera setups

  - Blend file includes lighting provided by the included HDRI map downloaded from HDRI Haven

  - Asset has been exported in 4 file formats (FBX, OBJ, GLTF/GLB, DAE/Collada)

  - Files have been archived in an easy to follow hierarchy

  - Images were rendered using the cycles engine

  - Wireframes were rendered using Marmoset Toolbag 3

Included Textures:

  - AO, Diffuse, Roughness, Gloss, Metallic

  - UVLayout

description_text:
Model of a luggage barrow.
The model is done in real world dimensions, the barrow overall size is 3,00m length, 1,25m wide and 1,41 high.
The model is organized in two objects: 

  - one for the whole barrow including frame, plattform, wheels, which is subdivision ready.

  - one object for all bolts and screws, to keep it outside of a subdivision. The bolts and the general mesh have the same origin, the bolts are parented to the general mesh.

The model is delivered with textures for a pbr-metalness/roughness-workflow.In order to use the maximum resolution for texturing, mirrored parts like the wheels, the bolts and the bumbers are mirrored on the texture set.
You will receive a texture set in 3072x3072 and in 4096x4096, including each a map for DIFFUSE - METALNESS - ROUGHNESS - NORMALS.  All parts of the mesh are using the same material/texture-set.
File Formats:

  - blend 2.91 (native, texture packed in file) and blend 2.79

  - fbx / 3ds / obj and mtl / dae (quads and triangles)

  - zip file for textures in 4K

  - zip file for textures in 3K

  - zip file for preview-pictures

Materials are only applied in the blend-files, in other file formats, if textures are not connected automatically by your software during import, you have to do it manually.
The studio-setup is not part of the package.

description_text:
Speed ​​Cola is a Perk-a-Cola that appears in Call of Duty: World at War, Call of Duty: Black Ops, and Call of Duty: Black Ops II in the Zombies game mode. Having this perk decreases the reload time of your weapons by 50%. Speed ​​Cola costs 3000 points, making it the second most expensive Perk-a-Cola, just behind Mule Kick. Its effect is most useful and noticeable on weapons with slow reload times, but due to its high cost it is not advisable to buy it before Jugger-Nog, unless absolutely necessary. The Speed ​​Cola drink machine has a green and white color scheme. The color of this perk is green, and the icon is a hand holding a charger. Speed ​​Cola appears on all Zombies maps, except Nacht der Untoten, Bus Stop, and Dead Ops Arcade.
This model includes the .ma (original), .fbx, .obj, .blend, .stl, .c4d, .dae and .glb formats and their respective 4K textures.

A DISC BRAKE IS A TYPE OF BRAKE THAT USES THE CALIPERS TO SQUEEZE PAIRS OF PADS AGAINST A DISC OR A ROTOR TO CREATE FRICTION. THIS ACTION SLOWS THE ROTATION OF A SHAFT, SUCH AS A VEHICLE AXLE, EITHER TO REDUCE ITS ROTATIONAL SPEED OR TO HOLD IT STATIONARY. THE ENERGY OF MOTION IS CONVERTED INTO WASTE HEAT WHICH MUST BE DISPERSED.
A MOTORCYCLE WITH DISC BRAKES HAS TWO PADS SQUEEZING EITHER SIDE OF A DISC-SHAPED METAL ROTOR. DRUM BRAKES, ON THE OTHER HAND, HAVE ‘SHOES’ THAT PRESS INTO AN ENCLOSED METAL ‘DRUM.’ AND, WHILE DISC BRAKES TYPICALLY RELY ON HYDRAULIC PRESSURE TO RETRACT THE PADS, DRUM BRAKES USE SPRINGS, CRUISER EXPLAINS.
HYDRAULICALLY ACTUATED DISC BRAKES ARE THE MOST COMMONLY USED FORM OF BRAKE FOR MOTOR VEHICLES, BUT THE PRINCIPLES OF A DISC BRAKE ARE APPLICABLE TO ALMOST ANY ROTATING SHAFT. THE COMPONENTS INCLUDE THE DISC, MASTER CYLINDER, CALIPER (WHICH CONTAINS CYLINDER AND TWO BRAKE PADS) ON BOTH SIDES OF THE DISC.

description_text:
These are the 3D print files for a set of Ursa Wren or Bo Katan gauntlets from Season 4 of Star Wars Rebels 3D animated series. (not the clone wars version) 
There are some subtle differences between Ursa and Bos gauntlets but mostly in color.
These files have been successfully test printed in ABS but have been designed with an integrated locking mechanism that requires the use of a steel bicycle spoke (2mm rod) which is used as a locking pin.  As such they do not have an visibule hinge lines and are very screen accurate.
They come with ALL the files you need however the part I called chopstick is probably better replaced with either a metal or flexible rod or an actual thin chopstick.
The files also include all the Lighted parts are separate parts so they can be printed in translucent plastic and LED backlit

description_text:
This Futuristic Concept Car 3D Model is a uniquely stylized, high-quality vehicle asset designed for use in sci-fi, cyberpunk, and advanced tech-themed projects. The model features an aerodynamic body, a bold dual-tone color scheme, and an abstract rear spoiler design that pushes the boundaries of modern car concepts. Its aggressive styling and forward-thinking form make it perfect for next-gen video games, films, animations, or virtual showrooms.
Key Features:
Highly Detailed Design: Distinctive curves, layered bodywork, and futuristic detailing offer a visually striking silhouette.
Unique Rear Fin Architecture: Sculptural rear spoiler adds a bold, artistic flair—perfect for sci-fi environments or alien-tech car culture.
Game & Render Ready: Clean topology and optimized geometry make it suitable for both real-time engines (Unity/Unreal) and high-end renders.
Clean UVs and Materials: Properly unwrapped UVs with material assignments ready for texture application (PBR or stylized).
Realistic Wheels and Rims: Custom futuristic wheel design included, with clean detailing ideal for close-up shots.
Technical Specifications:
Model Format: .FBX, .OBJ, .BLEND, .STL (Optional), .DAE
Poly Count: Mid to High Poly (perfect for cinematic use or can be decimated for game optimization)
Textures: Not included (can be added upon request), UV-mapped for easy customization
Rigging: Not rigged (can be rigged for animation on request)
Scale: Real-world scale units (meters)
Ideal Use Cases:
AAA Game Development: Fits right into sci-fi racing, futuristic warfare, or dystopian open-world games.
Virtual Production: Ready for use in Unreal Engine or Unity-based real-time cinematic scenes.
3D Animation/Short Films: Great for short sci-fi animations or concept trailers.
Concept Art & Product Visualization: Use for presentations, pitch decks, or showrooms focused on futuristic automotive designs.
VR/AR Applications: Lightweight enough to adapt for immersive experiences.
What You Get:
Fully modeled 3D concept car
UV-unwrapped geometry
Native and export formats: .blend, .fbx, .obj, .dae, optional .stl
Clean topology and subdivision-friendly mesh

description_text:
Did you ever need some train tracks for your project?Then this could be for you.
I added a low poly version for straight tracks and a mid version for curvy ones.The difference is that the mid version will create smoother curves because of more cuts on the steel track.The Gravel is just basic, but a single object. That means you can use the tracks without them and build in yourown gravel if you want.
I also added the .blend file. That is necessary as train tracks come in many different gauges.Simply change the distance of the steel track in the center to adjust the gauge of the track.
But wait there is more! (I always wanted to write an ad like that haha)The track comes with two different textures for the steel track (clean and rusty) and two different textures for the ground bares (wood and concrete).
That means you can create the variation you want with the steel/rusty track, the wood/concrete bares and with or without (or with your own) gravel.
I avoided repetations on the texture so you can create an array of the object to create a complete track.
Some words for the polycount. Do not underestimate it, the low version has ~9k and the mid version ~11k polys.Gravel is half of it, so if you do not want to use it you can safe some of your poly budget.
